subject: [D-RUG]: Help converting coordinates into climate classification?

messages.author: b77f9557fee404f5
messages.subject: [D-RUG]: Help converting coordinates into climate classification?
parts:
Hey D-RUG,

I'm hoping to turn a bunch of latitude/longitude coordinates into climate region classifications (e.g. Köppen or something similar). Anyone had experience doing this and have R packages to recommend?

Thanks!
Jennifer

--
Jennifer Schmidt

PhD Candidate
Horticulture and Agronomy -- Gaudin Lab
Department of Plant Sciences,
University of California -- Davis
jensc...@ucdavis.edu

messages.author: 1297ca138cdf6bfa
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Help converting coordinates into climate classification?
parts:
Hey Jen, 

Looks like theres a site dedicated to it with an R script available (attached here also, non package, just annotations). Make sure to setwd first, and see line 66 for entering lat long.

http://koeppen-geiger.vu-wien.ac.at/present.htm

nice because there's also a citable paper with it http://koeppen-geiger.vu-wien.ac.at/pdf/Paper_2017.pdf

Toby
